compare.description: Comparative evaluation of guideline adherence across clinical therapeutic topics.

topics.cardiorenal: SGLT2 Inhibitor initiation criteria, eGFR dosage titration, & cardiorenal safety thresholds
topics.lipids: Very high-risk ASCVD intensive lipid lowering targets (<55 mg/dL) & combination therapy
topics.heart: Early recognition of subtle HFpEF decompensation, NT-proBNP cutoff interpretation
topics.nutrition: Dietary sodium restriction, potassium management in CKD Stage 3b-4, and MNT
topics.other: Clinical decision guidance and guideline adherence evaluation

recommendations.cardiorenal: Reinforce eGFR monitoring cadences and safety pauses during acute dehydrating illness.
recommendations.lipids: Promote earlier non-statin ezetimibe/PCSK9i combination therapy in very-high-risk patients.
recommendations.heart: Emphasize biomarker-driven diagnostic pathways for HFpEF detection prior to overt congestion.
recommendations.nutrition: Provide practical dietary guidance on potassium-sparing combinations for chronic kidney disease.

stats.archetype_evidence_seeking_early_adopter: You tend to go for the newer option when there is evidence behind it. Worth double-checking that the evidence really is there each time.

stats.archetype_diagnostic_evidence_builder_de: You like to get the facts confirmed before acting. That habit catches problems early.
stats.archetype_balanced_clinician_desc: Your answers do not lean strongly in any one direction — you weigh each situation on its own.
